atoms.exact_source_text: When a named Citizen dies or is permanently abandoned tharn, their Tool and unspent Supply leave play without a recovery, salvage, or redistribution prompt.
atoms.normalized_claim: When a named Citizen dies or is permanently abandoned tharn, their Tool and unspent Supply leave play without any recovery, salvage, or redistribution prompt.

atoms.exact_source_text: The event follows the Citizen, not their inventory.
atoms.normalized_claim: The loss event follows the Citizen, not their inventory.

atoms.exact_source_text: A non-flight aftermath may later create a player-controlled Keepsake opportunity for a survivor, using the deceased Citizen's Keepsake or another object from the remains.
atoms.normalized_claim: A non-flight aftermath may later create a player-controlled Keepsake opportunity for a survivor, using the deceased Citizen's Keepsake or another object from the remains.
The Keepsake-transfer procedure for aftermath survivors is intentionally deferred.
Nothing transfers automatically from a deceased Citizen's remains.

atoms.exact_source_text: Every named arrival already has a life.
atoms.normalized_claim: Every named arrival already has a life.

atoms.exact_source_text: Core and Guest species use one Citizen architecture
atoms.normalized_claim: Core and Guest species use one shared Citizen architecture.

atoms.exact_source_text: arrival status does not create lesser slots, restricted Tool classes, special ownership, or delayed Keepsake validity.
atoms.normalized_claim: Arrival status does not create lesser slots, restricted Tool classes, special ownership, or delayed Keepsake validity.

atoms.exact_source_text: An arrival may bring a Tool grounded in their Prior-Life Tale.
atoms.normalized_claim: An arrival may bring a Tool grounded in their Prior-Life Tale.

atoms.exact_source_text: It enters as an ordinary named Tool and may later be reassigned like any other Tool.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool an arrival brings enters as an ordinary named Tool and may later be reassigned like any other Tool.

atoms.exact_source_text: An arrival may bring an established Keepsake grounded in prior life.
atoms.normalized_claim: An arrival may bring an established Keepsake grounded in prior life.

atoms.exact_source_text: It is already bonded and mechanically valid under ordinary Keepsake rules.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Keepsake an arrival brings is already bonded and mechanically valid under ordinary Keepsake rules.

atoms.exact_source_text: An arrival does not bring a tracked Supply.
atoms.normalized_claim: An arrival does not bring a tracked Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: Consumable preparation begins when the player sends them on their first Expedition.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consumable preparation for an arrival begins when the player sends them on their first Expedition.

atoms.exact_source_text: An arrival brings a life, not an empty character sheet.
atoms.normalized_claim: An arrival brings a life, not an empty character sheet.
